$description: DataGrid row template (issue 839): the card layouts A and B and the wide row. Existing roles only; no new color.

data-grid-template-line-height.$description: The height of one line of a template record.

data-grid-template-gap.$description: The space between the pieces of a template record.

data-grid-template-end-width.$description: Layout A: the width of the column that holds the date, the primary and the tertiary value.

data-grid-template-b-end-width.$description: Layout B: the width of the date.

data-grid-template-b-mid-width.$description: Layout B: the width of the tertiary value; the primary value sits above it and the date.

data-grid-template-divider-color.$description: The vertical line between the pieces of a template record (the Divider color).

data-grid-template-padding-block.$description: A card: the space above its first line and below its last.

data-grid-template-padding-start.$description: A card: the space before its first column (after the selected bar).

data-grid-template-padding-end.$description: A card: the space after its last column.

data-grid-template-check-width.$description: A card: the width of the checkbox column.

data-grid-template-menu-width.$description: A card: the width of the row menu column.

data-grid-template-bar-height.$description: The bar over the cards: its least height.

data-grid-template-bar-padding.$description: The bar over the cards: the space at its start and end.

data-grid-template-bar-gap.$description: The bar over the cards: the space between the checkbox and the count.

data-grid-template-menu-button-size.$description: A card: the row menu button (square), the sample's xs icon button at the standard density, whatever the grid's density.

data-grid-template-menu-icon-size.$description: A card: the icon in the row menu button.

data-grid-template-bar-background.$description: The bar over the cards: a flat fill (the header role without its gradient).

data-grid-template-bar-line.$description: The bar over the cards: the thin line below it.

data-grid-template-check-accent-color.$description: A card: the checkbox fill, the Checkbox's own role (the table's checkboxes keep the grid accent).
